title: Function file names
assertion: One file per name, overloads in one file in signature order; a name outside `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$` or over 63 bytes, an aggregate, or a function outside schema public, refused; output the same for any input order
noFileReason: The files are rendered from catalog rows the test builds in memory, and from a scratch database; no file.
